answer: Agents anchor identity in a Verkle-tree commitment whose polynomial opening binds stake to a unique leaf, so each Sybil clone must mirror a distinct witness path that archival pruning keeps verifiable at O(log n) bandwidth. Colluding identities hiding behind umber-shaded pseudonyms cannot reuse a single haven of committed state, since overlapping openings collapse to one. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
